title: Altair 8800 - Video #7.1 - Loading 4K BASIC with a Teletype
summary: A demonstration of loading Altair 4K BASIC on an Altair 8800 clone, using a front-panel bootloader and an ASR-33 Teletype. It shows the full sequence of entering boot code, loading BASIC and running a program.
why: Cited as a great demo of how early microcomputers were actually booted and operated.

quote.text: There's a nice video here of a complete BASIC boot sequence
